coming_soon_text: Coming soon: An archive documenting the birth of New Hollywood, with material that reveals how a generation of filmmakers reinvented American cinema; working storyboards by Buckminster Fuller integrating the geometric, planetary, and social foundations of Spaceship Earth, with Indira Gandhi, Golda Meir, and Jiang Qing circled at the center; an Einstein mini notebook documenting a key phase of work toward General Relativity, and more.
